You can still lock in your Apple TV 4K pre-order discount before delivery dates slip ever further, much like the new HomeView, and we also have AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off. But today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by iPhone Duo-ready Apple Pencil (USB-C) as low as $61 at Amazon (more details here), alongside a giant $900 price drop at Amazon on this 36GB M5 Max MacBook Pro (the lowest price ever). We have MacBook Neo at $120 off courtesy of the Apple refurb store, these 240W USB-C cables with mini displays at just $12 each, and much more below.

Upgrade your iPhone Duo setup with a fresh set of AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off

The new 2026 iPhone Pro lineup has arrived, iPhone Duo (hands-on review right here) will begin shipping tomorrow, and aside from maybe scoring a new case to keep them safe, AirPods Pro 3 remain the best accessory for any iPhone if you ask me. I love the idea of adding some tracking capabilities with AirTag 2, but AirPods Pro 3 are still the most useful and actively functional add-on there is and you can still score them at $50 off via Amazon.

Amazon is currently Apple’s latest and greatest in-ear experience down at $199 shipped – AirPods Pro carry a $249 list price and they are currently $50 off.

We were tracking them down at $179 as part of the fall Prime Day event earlier this month, but they are still on sale and within $20 of the lowest price we have tracked since late June 2026. The fall Prime event was, in fact, the only time they have sold for less than they are right now in the last 4 months.

Land iPhone Duo-ready Apple Pencil (USB-C) as low as $61 at Amazon

Official Apple Pencil support for Apple’s new foldable is actually landing well ahead of schedule – you will need Apple Pencil (USB-C) to make use of it though.

Apple Pencil (USB-C) is the only model iPhone Duo will support starting next week – your Apple Pencil Pro or Apple Pencil 2 will not work.

Fortunately, Amazon is offering Apple Pencil (USB-C) down at $69 shipped right now, or 13% under the regular $79 list price.

And you can score one for even less by way of Amazon Used: Like New listings.

Head over to this page, and select “Other sellers on Amazon” link below the Add to Cart button – this is where you’ll find the best quality Used: Like New option down at $61.29 shipped.

Lock your Apple TV 4K pre-order discount in now before delivery times slip into late December

Everyday that goes by, delivery times for the new Apple TV 4K begin to slip further into November and even December in some locations. Unlike some of its HomeView listings, Amazon’s Apple TV 4K listing is not estimating time of arrival until pre-orders are placed at this point. It still appears to be shipping it faster than Apple to some locations, and at a lower price though.

Amazon still has the new Apple TV 4K sitting down at $289.99. That’s clearly not a giant deal, but it is lower than Apple and perhaps enough reason to pre-order at Amazon despite the delivery delay.

Some users are reporting that shipping times at Amazon have also slipped into late November and December at this point, and we are seeing that in some places of the country as well. But it also appears to be getting them out faster than Apple in some regions as well.

As of right now, Apple is listing pre-order deliveries at between November 30 and December 7. This is usually an accurate estimate when it comes to Apple’s deliveries so you can use this data to compare against Amazon, the problem is you’ll have to wait until after your pre-order is placed at Amazon to find out at this point.

Apple’s 36GB M5 Max MacBook is a massive $900 off today (Amazon all-time low)

Okay, well, this is one beast of a M5 Max MacBook Pro, but the deal is just too deep to ignore. Needless to say this one is certainly not for everyone, but Amazon is offering the 2026 M5 Max MacBook Pro with the 16-inch display and 36GB of RAM at a massive $900 off right now.

Amazon is offering the 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro with 36GB of RAM and the 2TB storage capacity at $3,499 shipped.

That a crazy expensive laptop, for sure, but we are talking about a super powerful machine that carries an insane $4,399 list price here.

Not only is this $900 off the Apple price tag, but this is a good deal even by pre-price hike standards.

As we have discussed previously, the real measure of how good a deal on a current-generation MacBook is these days is how the current deal price compares to the pre-price hike list. This machine launched earlier this year at $3,899 and is now $400 less than that despite the late June increase.

More to the point, we have never tracked this machine for less than $3,649 at Amazon, before or after the price increase, until now.

Score MacBook Neo at $120 under the list price straight from the Apple refurb store (Full warranty)

While we are tracking $150 price drops on the latest M5 MacBook Air models at Amazon this week, if you’re looking to upgrade your Mac for a fraction of the price, the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is a great option and it has the 512GB MacBook Neo back in-stock at $679 – that’s $120 under the new list price.

At this point, the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store only has the upgraded 512GB MacBook Neo with the new Touch ID keyboard in stock, and in all four colors. Regularly $799 brand new and almost never discounted by more than $10 or so at Amazon, you can score one straight from Apple down at $679 right now:

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB w/ Touch ID $679 (Reg. $799 new)

Apple’s 2026 M6 Mac mini is nearly $150 off right now

One of the more impressive hangover Apple deals we are still tracking from back during the fall Prime Day event is still live – the new 2026 M6 Mac mini at up to nearly $150 off.

This is not some slight early launch discount or $50 off or something, but rather a proper and rather impressive fall Prime Day deal that is somehow still live. The entry level model did drop down another $11 for a short time in the middle of the Prime Big Deal Days event in early October, but we are still tracking its initial Prime deal price as well as a near $150 off the mid-range 16GB/512GB config.

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB $780 (Reg. $899)
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB $950 (Reg. $1,099)

While the price of the Mac mini went up this generation, it is still one of the best bang for your buck options in the current-generation Mac lineup if you ask me, and one I have been leveraging for my day to day for years.

Popular new Airfly Drive CarPlay/Android Auto adapter back in-stock, delivery times starting to slip

Some of the hottest tech releases and pre-orders of the last couple months have sold out very quickly with delivery times get pushed well beyond release date, not unlike the new Apple HomeView and Twelve South’s new Airfly Drive wireless CarPlay and Android Auto adapter. The $40 Airfly Drive has been one of the most popular pickups around here and you might want to consider locking one in now before delivery times slip into December (or later).

One of my personal favorite charging stations is on sale again folks – the Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger. Now $50 off the list price, you can now score it within a few bucks of the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon.

The official Anker Amazon storefront is now offering its Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger down at $99.73 shipped.

  • This is one of the most affordable Qi2.2 25W wireless chargers with active cooling, now down to just $30 (40% off)
  • Sharge’s 140W 20,000mAh and 170W 24,000mAh power banks sit $5 above Prime Day pricing starting from $80

Apple’s 2026 all-glyph Magic Keyboard is sitting at the Amazon all-time low (Nearly 20% off)

Alongside the up to $150 price drops on the new M6 Mac mini, another one of the more impressive fall Prime Day hangover deals still live, that also happens to be the perfect companion piece, is Apple’s new Magic Keyboard – it is sitting at the Amazon all-time low right now.

Amazon is now offering the 2026 Apple Magic Keyboard down at $79.99 shipped.

This is the new all-glyph model in its base and most affordable capacity that regularly carries a $99 list price. This deal knocks nearly 20% off to deliver the lowest we have tracked since release a couple months back.

Deals on official Magic accessories have historically been somewhat rare, so we wanted to circle back on this deal while it was up for grabs. You’re effectively looking at the fall Prime Day price here today, it just happens to still be live and ready for the taking.

For those unfamiliar, this brand new model is largely the same as the previous iteration that was updated with a USB-C charging port, but Apple has tweaked the design language here a touch. Falling in line with the keyboards on the latest MacBook releases, it has removed some of the text on select function keys in favor of a super clean, (mostly) all-glyph approach.
